benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Climbed to about $111.86 on 22 Oct (Trading Economics), a new five-month high, up roughly 6.9% w/w, on new but still-unconfirmed Houthi claims of strikes on a Saudi oil field and an airport, as UKMTO data showed ship attacks near the Arabian Peninsula have more than doubled in October versus September. Week-ago is this site's 15 Oct reading, exactly 7 days earlier.

note: Brent and WTI set fresh five-month highs on 22 October as the Houthis claimed new, still-unconfirmed strikes on a Saudi oil field and an airport, and UKMTO data showed ship attacks near the Arabian Peninsula have more than doubled in October versus September, even as Middle East oil flows hold near pre-war levels on bypass routes. TTF and JKM climbed back toward their 19 Oct 2026 highs, with JKM setting a new one; Henry Hub continued easing.
